query.sql: SELECT CASE g.code WHEN 'S1' THEN '手机' WHEN 'S2' THEN 'AIoT' WHEN 'S3' THEN '互联网' WHEN 'S4' THEN '汽车' WHEN 'S5' THEN 'AI等新业务' ELSE g.name END AS part,g.value/s.shares AS v, 10+coalesce(nullif(regexp_replace(g.code,'\D','','g'),'')::int,0) AS ord FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id=s.company_id AND co.code='01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id=s.model_id AND m.status='当前' JOIN vi_sotp_segment_val g ON g.scenario_id=s.id AND g.model_id=s.model_id WHERE s.is_base UNION ALL SELECT x.part,x.v/s.shares,x.ord FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id=s.company_id AND co.code='01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id=s.model_id AND m.status='当前' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('可用净现金',s.usable_net_cash,30),('对外投资',s.investments,31),('其他调整',s.asset_value-s.usable_net_cash-s.investments,32),('合计',s.equity_value,40),('市场价',s.market_price*s.shares,41)) x(part,v,ord) WHERE s.is_base ORDER BY ord

titleDescription.title: 基准每股价值桥接（人民币元）

query.sql: SELECT x.m AS "倍数", s.scenario_name AS "系列", round(((coalesce(s.core_earnings, 0) * x.m + coalesce(s.mature_earn_pv, 0) * x.m + coalesce(s.mature_interim_pv, 0) + coalesce(s.growth_value, 0) + coalesce(s.invest_value, 0) + coalesce(s.direct_value, 0) + s.noncore) / s.shares)::numeric, 2) AS "每股价值", s.id FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = s.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base cm ON cm.id=s.model_id AND cm.status='当前' CROSS JOIN generate_series(4, 24, 2) x(m) UNION ALL SELECT x.m, '市场价', round(s.market_price::numeric, 2), 999 FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = s.company_id AND co.code = '01810.HK' JOIN vi_model_base cm ON cm.id=s.model_id AND cm.status='当前' CROSS JOIN generate_series(4, 24, 2) x(m) WHERE s.is_base ORDER BY 1, 4
